origin: New root mathematical proposal only; unverified; no theorem grant
hypotheses_to_establish_first: General prescribed-type bounded energy/operator constructions in the frozen rounds29/30 proposal, including signed IBP and all degree>d mixed vanishing.
Energy representative independence and genuine homogeneous polynomial dependence of degree m=n-d on the auxiliary Kahler class, with all cohomology relations, reference and raw mass checked.

energy_compression.V: Finite-dimensional real H^(1,1)(X); the Kahler cone is open in V. Fix the actual theta-psh anchor psi and common bounded type C_psi; d is actual prescribed-current degree, m=n-d.
energy_compression.polynomials: For each u in C_psi, p_u(lambda)=E_(psi,lambda)(u). If the proposed energy theorem holds, p_u is a genuine degree-m homogeneous polynomial on the Kahler cone and has a unique polarization ell_u in (Sym^m V)^*. Prove it descends from chosen smooth representatives; do not assume it merely from a symbolic expression.
energy_compression.S_psi: The span of all ell_u is a finite-dimensional subspace of (Sym^m V)^*. This retains actual psi-type, not ideal-equivalence alone. Give a definition using the explicit mixed energy integrals and any temporary finite basis of closed representatives, then prove basis independence.
energy_compression.reference: The auxiliary energy reference could be q_psi(lambda^m) in Sym^m V / Ann(S_psi), restricted to the image of the Kahler cone. It is a scale datum with raw mass, not a probability normalization.
energy_compression.minimality: Two auxiliary classes induce exactly the same anchored energy for every u in C_psi iff their symmetric powers have the same image under q_psi. Prove both directions, all anchor-change compatibility, and exactly the sense in which this is necessary/sufficient. Do not label a tautological equivalence on energies themselves a geometric classification. This gives a finite-dimensional explicit quotient only after the previous polynomial theorem is proved.
energy_compression.raw_mass: Constant shifts u=psi+c must belong to C_psi and yield p_(psi+c)=c*M_d(psi,lambda). Thus the mass polynomial is in S_psi and descends to q_psi. No raw mass is recovered from I-equivalence or division by zero volume.
energy_compression.anchor_change: For chi in C_psi, cocycle suggests p_u^chi=p_u^psi-p_chi^psi, with p_psi^chi=-p_chi^psi. These identities should prove equality of the spans S_chi=S_psi and a canonical identification of reference quotients. Check every potential, current and mass convention.
energy_compression.finite_energy: If an actual finite-energy extension is obtained, determine whether its energies yield the same polynomial span/reference quotient, rather than assuming finite-energy limits preserve every auxiliary-path estimate.
energy_compression.example: Already known comparison, not a new solved theorem: on P1xP1 with theta=pr1*beta and bounded pullback type psi=0, energy for omega=a*theta+b*pr2*eta depends only on b, although auxiliary classes vary with a. Hence the entire auxiliary class is not necessary in this example; a minimum-data claim should address this.

operator_compression.space: Let W be the real vector space of closed smooth (m,m)-forms on X. For each common-type u, define L_u(eta)=<T_u^d> wedge eta, a signed top-degree current. Prove it is well-defined and linear.
operator_compression.kernel: N_psi=intersection_(u in C_psi) ker L_u. The image of omega^m in W/N_psi could be the necessary and sufficient full-form data for all resulting measures. This is generally infinite-dimensional and need not descend to a cohomology class.
operator_compression.minimality_limit: Equality of all actual operators iff equality in this quotient follows from its defining kernels; by itself that is not a geometric classification. Investigate an independently geometric description and any smaller actual carrier before claiming full original closure.
operator_compression.mass: On the quotient image of positive auxiliary forms, raw mass is the total mass of the actual measure. Verify it descends and distinguish measure-reference data from the finite-dimensional energy quotient.
operator_compression.degree_zero: At d=0, all operators on X equal omega^n regardless of u. Investigate whether common-type potentials necessarily differ by constants (requires a real proof of the Dirichlet/Sobolev identification), allowing an intrinsic singleton carrier with a positive scalar scale. Do not assume this identification from formal vanishing alone.

unresolved: No new bounded energy or operator theorem is accepted by this future proposal.
Finite-dimensional energy quotient minimality is conditional on genuine polynomial and cohomology invariance proofs.
A quotient definition alone is not independently geometric carrier identification.
General finite-energy/path continuity and numerical-dimension/geometric-carrier requirements remain open.
